Keel

Release notes

Version 1.1.1 In review

Waiting for Chrome Web Store review

Ashby applications saved properly, and tidy confirmations on every site.

  • On Ashby, Keel saves the real job description and company name, even when you apply from the application tab
  • Keel's confirmation and other notes on a page no longer draw their lines on top of each other on some sites

Version 1.1.0 Latest

14 November 2026

Insights, Naukri, and quieter autofill.

  • Insights: see which sites, kinds of role and résumés get you answers, interviews and offers, shown only when the numbers are big enough to mean something
  • Saves applications on Naukri, including Apply from job lists, Naukri's questions and its apply chat (needs access to all sites)
  • Fields Keel fills from your saved answers get a small badge you can hover to undo, instead of a thick outline
  • Job descriptions keep their paragraph breaks, and removing Keel opens a short feedback form

Version 1.0.0

14 November 2026

The first version of Keel.

  • Saves the jobs you apply to on LinkedIn, Greenhouse and six more job sites, with the job description and the résumé you sent
  • Turn it on for all sites to save applications on company careers sites too
  • A Today list in the popup: interviews coming up, follow-ups due and open offers
  • Optional Gmail updates, saved answers for repeated questions, and interview reminders
  • Export and import your data; everything stays on your device
